title: Nested Objects
description: An object typed parameter carrying its own nested properties.
question: Does nested structure survive to each capture boundary?
notes: Nested input survives everywhere measured. A reference based encoding is an equivalent representation, not a loss.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: nested types are re expressed via `$defs` and `$ref`. Semantically equivalent, so mcp-mirror resolves the reference before comparing rather than reporting it as flattening.

verdict.headline: Survives to all five declared capture boundaries.
verdict.detail: One framework re expresses nesting by reference. The structure is preserved either way.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: If nested structure were flattened or dropped, complex calls would silently degrade.
